column3: Contempt of a Court,Tribunal or Institution
4.  (1)  Any  publication  or  expression  of  accurate  facts
made  in  good  faith  of  a  judge  or  judicial  officer  or,
proceeding,  judgment  or  order  of  a  court,  tribunal  or
institution as the case may be, on a matter of public interest
shall not be deemed to be contempt of such court, tribunal
or institution, where the risk of causing any impediment or
prejudice  to  such  judge  or  judicial  officer  or  proceeding,
judgement or order is merely incidental.
